title: vireshkoli/LLM-Inference-Optimization
summary: 该项目对量化Llama-3.1-8B服务（vLLM vs SGLang）在NVIDIA A40上的延迟、吞吐量、质量和成本进行了严格的基准测试，包括泊松到达、尾部延迟、帕累托前沿，并提供了一种可审计的方法。项目使用Python语言实现，专注于模型推理优化。，基于模型推理的架构
description: Rigorous open-loop latency/throughput/quality/cost benchmarking of quantized Llama-3.1-8B serving (vLLM vs SGLang) on an NVIDIA A40 — Poisson arrivals, tail latency, Pareto frontier, and a methodology you can audit.
